projectTitle: BROKEN: Building Resilient Optimized Engineered Networks
projectTitle_zh: BROKEN: Building Resilient Optimized Engineered Networks
tagline: Bringing failure analysis from mature engineering disciplines into synthetic biology: detect, mitigate and predict how genetic circuits break.
tagline_zh: 把成熟工程領域的失效分析帶進合成生物學：偵測、緩解並預測基因迴路是怎麼壞掉的。
summary: William & Mary argued that synthetic biology measures whether a circuit works and almost never measures how long it keeps working. BROKEN therefore ran longitudinal experiments on four previously engineered circuits in laboratory cultures and in seawater microcosms, following them through serial passaging to deterioration rather than stopping at initial success. The team paired functional readouts (OD600, beta-carotene production, GFP, biofilm morphology, starch hydrolysis, colony-forming units) with molecular verification (PCR, restriction digests, gels, NanoDrop) and with multi-omics (RNA-seq, genomic DNA sequencing, long-read plasmid sequencing), then built mechanistic ODE models and machine-learning approaches to predict time to failure. The reliability framing came directly from Integrated Human Practices and turned safety into the project's central motivation, which is reflected in its Safety and Security Award.
summary_zh: William & Mary 主張合成生物學一向只量迴路「會不會動」，幾乎從不量它「還能動多久」。因此 BROKEN 對四個先前已工程改造的迴路做縱向實驗，在實驗室培養液與海水微宇宙中，透過連續傳代一路追到功能衰退，而不是在初步成功時就停下。團隊把功能性讀值（OD600、beta-胡蘿蔔素產量、GFP、生物膜形態、澱粉水解、菌落形成單位）與分子層面的驗證（PCR、限制酶切、電泳膠、NanoDrop）以及多體學（RNA-seq、基因體 DNA 定序、長讀長質體定序）配在一起，再建立機制性 ODE 模型與機器學習方法來預測失效時間。這套以可靠性為核心的框架直接來自整合式人類實踐，把安全變成整個專案的主要動機，而這也反映在他們拿到的 Safety and Security Award 上。

dry.frameworks: A stated measurement philosophy of multitiered (population, circuit output, viability, DNA integrity, transcription), multimodal (optical, biochemical, microbiological, sequencing) and redundant measurement, with the explicit rationale that a falling fluorescence signal could equally mean circuit dysfunction, reduced growth, altered reporter maturation or changed physiology. An extension of the standard Design-Build-Test-Learn cycle so that engineering does not end at a functioning construct but continues through systematic longevity and failure testing in both laboratory and realistic environmental conditions, with results feeding back into design.
dry.frameworks_zh: 他們寫明一套量測哲學：多層次（族群、迴路輸出、存活率、DNA 完整性、轉錄）、多模態（光學、生化、微生物學、定序）且具冗餘的量測，理由也說得清楚——螢光訊號下降，同樣可能代表迴路失能、生長變慢、報告蛋白成熟改變，或生理狀態改變。他們也擴充了標準的 Design-Build-Test-Learn 循環，使工程不在「構築體能運作」時就結束，而是繼續走到實驗室與真實環境條件下的系統性壽命與失效測試，並把結果回饋到設計。
dry.dataviz: Longitudinal fluorescence and beta-carotene time-course figures, kill-switch and thymineless-death assay panels, DNA mutation tables for the corrosion-prevention construct, leakiness panels and circuit-expression comparisons across experiments, all numbered as a continuous figure series across the results and measurement pages.
dry.dataviz_zh: 縱向螢光與 beta-胡蘿蔔素的時間序列圖、致死開關與缺胸腺嘧啶死亡分析的面板、防腐蝕構築體的 DNA 突變表、洩漏表現面板，以及跨實驗的迴路表現比較，全部以連續編號的圖序貫穿結果頁與量測頁。
dry.datascience: The headline measurement contribution is absolute-style fluorescence calibration: the team prepared concentration series of fluorescein and sulforhodamine 101 in PBS, measured four replicates at each concentration with PBS blanks to assess solvent background, fitted linear regressions of fluorophore concentration against RFU with reported R2 greater than 0.99, and then used published extinction coefficients and quantum yields to estimate conversion factors between the calibration dyes and S65T GFP, mKate2, mCherry and cpGFP, so that plate-reader readings could enter the mathematical models as concentration-like variables instead of instrument-dependent arbitrary units. They state the limitation plainly, that because dye and protein optical properties differ these conversions are estimates contingent on the correction factors. Normalisation is handled explicitly: beta-carotene is reported as A454/OD600 so that per-cell production is separated from cell number, uncontaminated LB is measured as a blank, and OD600 is used both to standardise serial transfers and to interpret every fluorescence comparison. Where optical turbidity cannot answer the biological question, the technique changes: CFU counts are used for kill-switch viability and for thymineless death and rescue, on the advice of Dr Andrei Kuzminov, with plating on thymidine-supplemented medium so that the assay does not itself impose further starvation. Reporter maturation delay was built into measurement timing after Dr Sean Sleight pointed out that a delay in fluorescence is not a delay in transcription. The RNA-seq pipeline is specified end to end: fastp for adapter trimming and quality filtering, SortMeRNA for residual rRNA removal, HISAT2 alignment against combined host-plus-plasmid references built as merged FASTA and GFF files, featureCounts for gene-level assignment and DESeq2 for differential expression; genome assemblies from Plasmidsaurus were annotated with Bakta in Geneious Prime and variant tables exported. Modelling carries uncertainty properly: SciPy least-squares fits of the lambda-repressor model give R2 = 0.82 and chi2/dof = 0.88 at 30 C, and the team reports that the 42 C prediction degrades to R2 = 0.55 with chi2/dof = 7.57, six to eight times worse than the in-sample value and therefore larger than measurement noise explains, rather than presenting the prediction as validated. A light-responsive fit is reported as poor at the assumed error (chi2/dof = 4.7, p = 0.0009) with the specific failure described (the dark curve fits, the light curve is flat then bursts). Because the labelled dataset is tiny (N = 16), model selection uses leave-one-out and leave-one-series-out rather than a train/test split, with benchmarking across OLS, Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net, random forest and Gaussian process; Ridge on circuit fraction plus stress genes gives leave-one-out R2 = 0.61, and a classifier reaches AUC 0.880 and accuracy 0.830, both reported with the caveat that 16 samples cannot establish a general predictor.
dry.datascience_zh: 最主要的量測貢獻是接近絕對值的螢光校正：團隊在 PBS 中配製螢光素與 sulforhodamine 101 的濃度系列，每個濃度測四個重複並以 PBS 空白評估溶劑背景，對螢光團濃度與 RFU 擬合線性迴歸、報告 R2 大於 0.99，再以已發表的吸光係數與量子產率估算校正染料與 S65T GFP、mKate2、mCherry 及 cpGFP 之間的換算因子，使盤式讀取儀的讀值能以「類似濃度」的變數進入數學模型，而不是以依賴儀器的任意單位進入。他們也把限制講白：因為染料與蛋白質的光學性質不同，這些換算只是估計值，且取決於那些校正因子。正規化處理得很明確：beta-胡蘿蔔素以 A454/OD600 報告，把每個細胞的產量與細胞數分開；未受污染的 LB 當空白量測；OD600 既用來標準化連續接種，也用來解讀每一次螢光比較。而當光學濁度回答不了生物學問題時，技術就換掉：依 Dr Andrei Kuzminov 的建議，致死開關的存活率以及缺胸腺嘧啶死亡與其救援都改用 CFU 計數，並塗在添加胸苷的培養基上，以免分析本身又施加額外的飢餓。在 Dr Sean Sleight 指出「螢光的延遲不等於轉錄的延遲」之後，報告蛋白的成熟延遲也被納入量測時程設計。RNA-seq 流程從頭到尾都寫明：以 fastp 做接頭修剪與品質過濾、SortMeRNA 去除殘餘 rRNA、以合併成單一 FASTA 與 GFF 檔的宿主加質體參考序列做 HISAT2 比對、featureCounts 做基因層級歸屬、DESeq2 做差異表現；來自 Plasmidsaurus 的基因體組裝則在 Geneious Prime 中以 Bakta 註解並匯出變異表。建模也把不確定性處理得妥當：以 SciPy 最小平方擬合 lambda 抑制子模型，在 30 degC 下得到 R2 = 0.82、chi2/dof = 0.88，而團隊報告 42 degC 的預測退化到 R2 = 0.55、chi2/dof = 7.57，比樣本內數值差六到八倍，因此大於量測雜訊所能解釋的範圍——他們沒有把這個預測當成已驗證。一個光反應模型的擬合則在假設誤差下被報為不佳（chi2/dof = 4.7，p = 0.0009），並描述出具體的失效形式（暗處的曲線擬合得好，光照的曲線先平坦後暴衝）。由於有標註的資料集極小（N = 16），模型選擇採留一法與留一序列法，而不是訓練/測試切分，並在 OLS、Ridge、Lasso、Elastic Net、隨機森林與高斯過程之間做基準比較；以迴路比例加上逆境基因為特徵的 Ridge 得到留一法 R2 = 0.61，分類器達到 AUC 0.880、準確率 0.830，而兩者都附上保留說明：16 個樣本無法確立一個通用的預測器。
dry.software: All modelling and analysis code is published with documentation on the team's iGEM GitLab, with instructions for both terminal use and a web interface. A Guidebook for Circuit Failure Measurement is released as a PDF, offering a tiered approach scaled to a laboratory's budget, from accessible functional assays through molecular diagnostics to sequencing and multi-omics. Longitudinal RNA-seq and DNA-seq datasets are released for the community, paired with functional, growth and viability measurements so that molecular change can be linked to observed performance. The hardware, software, alternative-platform and entrepreneurship wiki pages remain unfilled iGEM templates.
dry.software_zh: 所有建模與分析程式碼都連同文件發表在團隊的 iGEM GitLab 上，並附終端機與網頁介面兩種使用說明。另釋出一本 PDF 版的《迴路失效量測指南》，提供依實驗室預算分層的做法，從負擔得起的功能性分析，到分子診斷，再到定序與多體學。縱向 RNA-seq 與 DNA-seq 資料集也公開給社群，並與功能、生長與存活率量測配對，使分子層面的變化能和觀察到的效能連起來。至於 wiki 上的硬體、軟體、替代平台與創業頁面，仍停留在未填寫的 iGEM 範本。
techniques: Dye-to-protein conversion factors via extinction coefficient and quantum yield
CFU viability in place of turbidity
Longitudinal serial passaging to a failure endpoint
Model benchmarking on a fixed small dataset

good.ihp: Integrated Human Practices reframed the project three times over. Contributors from aerospace, civil and electrical engineering backgrounds pushed the team to adopt not only the methods of failure engineering but its mindset, that failure should be anticipated and designed for rather than observed after the fact. The most consequential shift was the recognition that circuit failure is a biosafety problem, not a performance problem, which moved safety from a secondary consideration to the central motivation and underpins the team's Safety and Security Award. Technical guidance entered the DBTL cycle directly: Dr Alex Porter pressed the team on the gap between laboratory performance and behaviour under realistic environmental conditions, which produced the seawater microcosm experiments; Dr Sean Sleight raised fluorescent-protein maturation, which changed measurement timing; and Dr Andrei Kuzminov argued that OD600 and fluorescence could not measure survival during thymineless death, which replaced the planned readout with CFU-based viability.
good.ihp_zh: 整合式人類實踐把這個專案重新框定了三次。來自航太、土木與電機工程背景的貢獻者，推動團隊不只採用失效工程的方法，更採用它的心態：失效應該被預期、被設計進去，而不是事後才觀察到。影響最大的轉變，是認知到迴路失效是生物安全問題，不是效能問題；這把安全從次要考量移到核心動機，也支撐起團隊的 Safety and Security Award。技術建議則直接進了 DBTL 循環：Dr Alex Porter 針對實驗室表現與真實環境條件下的行為落差施壓，因而產生海水微宇宙實驗；Dr Sean Sleight 提出螢光蛋白成熟的問題，改變了量測時程；而 Dr Andrei Kuzminov 主張 OD600 與螢光無法量測缺胸腺嘧啶死亡期間的存活，於是原定讀值被換成以 CFU 為基礎的存活率。
good.realWorld: The project's deliverables are aimed at the field rather than at a product: an open-source set of standard operating protocols written so that someone who was not present can follow them, a tiered Guidebook for Circuit Failure Measurement scaled to different budgets, publicly released longitudinal multi-omics datasets for comparative failure analysis and model validation, and a proposed extension of DBTL that adds systematic longevity and failure testing. The team also models building on previously published circuits rather than treating initial characterisation as an endpoint, and frames kill switches and other safety-critical circuits as the components that most need the failure analysis mature engineering disciplines already apply.
good.realWorld_zh: 這個專案的交付成果瞄準的是整個領域，而不是一項產品：一套開源的標準操作程序，寫法確保沒在現場的人也能照著做；一本依不同預算分層的《迴路失效量測指南》；公開釋出的縱向多體學資料集，供比較性失效分析與模型驗證使用；以及一項 DBTL 的擴充提案，加入系統性的壽命與失效測試。團隊也示範了在既有已發表迴路之上繼續做，而不是把初步特性化當成終點，並把致死開關與其他安全關鍵迴路定位為最需要成熟工程領域早已在做的那種失效分析的元件。

images.caption: Beta-carotene assay following circuit output over serial passaging. Absorbance at 454 nm is normalised to OD600 so that a fall in total pigment can be separated from a fall in cell number.
images.caption_zh: 追蹤連續傳代過程中迴路輸出的 beta-胡蘿蔔素分析。454 nm 的吸光度以 OD600 正規化，使總色素下降能與細胞數下降分開。

images.caption: Kill-switch assay. Colony-forming unit counts before and after induction are used instead of OD600 or fluorescence, because the intended output of a kill switch is loss of viability rather than loss of reporter signal.
images.caption_zh: 致死開關分析。誘導前後改用菌落形成單位計數，而非 OD600 或螢光，因為致死開關預期的輸出是失去存活力，而不是失去報告訊號。

images.caption: Thymineless rescue measured by CFU on thymidine-supplemented medium, an assay design adopted after Dr Andrei Kuzminov advised that optical density and fluorescence would not measure survival directly.
images.caption_zh: 以添加胸苷培養基上的 CFU 量測缺胸腺嘧啶後的救援；這個分析設計是在 Dr Andrei Kuzminov 指出光密度與螢光無法直接量測存活之後才採用的。

images.caption: GFP fluorescence time course for an engineered construct. Raw plate-reader RFU values are converted toward concentration-like units using fluorescein and sulforhodamine 101 calibration curves (R2 > 0.99) before entering the mathematical models.
images.caption_zh: 一個工程改造構築體的 GFP 螢光時間序列。盤式讀取儀的原始 RFU 值先以螢光素與 sulforhodamine 101 的校正曲線（R2 > 0.99）換算成類似濃度的單位，才進入數學模型。

gemsTakeaway: Calibrate fluorescence against a dye concentration series before any number leaves the plate reader, and report model fits with chi2/dof against the measurement error rather than R2 alone, so that an out-of-sample prediction that is six times worse than the in-sample fit is visible as a failure instead of being dressed up as a moderate correlation.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 在任何數字離開盤式讀取儀之前，先用一組染料濃度系列校正螢光；而模型擬合要用對照量測誤差的 chi2/dof 來報告，不要只報 R2——這樣一個比樣本內擬合差六倍的樣本外預測，才會被看成失效，而不是被包裝成「中等程度的相關」。
